description: This Java class 'DefaultStreamingConfig' provides the default implementation of the 'StreamingConfig' interface. It reads configuration parameters related to streaming, such as session scraping interval, parallelism, acknowledgement config, timeouts, websocket and SSE configurations, and signal enrichment configuration from a given 'Config' object. The class includes a static factory method to create an instance from a configuration source and overrides standard methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultStreamingConfig
